notes: Most recent Republican county committee election found: the June 4, 2024 primary. The June 2026 primary report lists county committee contests for Democrats only, and the June 2025 primary had none, so 2024 is the latest Republican election. The 2024 final summary report lists a 'County Committee Male' and 'County Committee Female' contest (vote for 1) for every one of 366 election districts, including uncontested ones. Filled = a Republican ballot candidate received votes and more than any other ballot candidate and more than all write-in votes combined. Empty = no ballot candidate and zero write-in votes. Unknown = no ballot candidate but write-in votes were cast (the report names write-in recipients, but write-in winners are not treated as verified filled seats and no names are stored). The 2024 report predates New Jersey's district-level privacy suppression, so no counts were suppressed. Seats reflect the 2024 election only; later appointments or resignations are not captured.
